description: Compact workflow plus verbatim rules; v48 base names and derived-object names require complete independent antecedents, preserving mathematical/statistical qualifiers, actual head span and object identity. Source-supported base-reference plus an explicit operation is distinct from naming a derived object; no automatic split on de, invented definitions, dropped qualifiers or substring passes. Sync claims/solution and valid counts in existing checks. All v45/v43/v44 and earlier limits retained; source edits require renewed coverage review. v50 consolidates full-object coverage, deduplication, identical notation and authorized normalization without removing existing boundaries; independently review this condensed summary and its conditional routes before release. v52 flowchart terminology covers actual raster/vector/editable text, reused figures and internal titles without protected-name exemption; source-grounded renaming preserves object and flow semantics, outside official names remain protected, and existing visual review/routes are reused. Unaffected valid internal titles and existing name protection outside flowchart scope remain unchanged.
